==={{header|FreeBASIC}}===
<syntaxhighlight lang="freebasic">#define UPTO 22
#include "isprime.bas"

dim as integer running = 0, curr=0
do 
    curr += 1
    if isprime(curr) then running += 1
    if running = UPTO then exit do
    print running;" ";
loop 
print : end
</syntaxhighlight>
